name: Mount Stuart
justification: Dominant non-volcanic peak of the central Cascades; summit panorama Rainier to Baker.

name: Burroughs Mountain
justification: One of the most dramatic views of Rainier, right against the NE face and Emmons Glacier; all above treeline.

name: Skyline Trail / Panorama Point (Paradise)
justification: Best hike in the park on several lists; Nisqually Glacier and Rainier's south face over meadows the whole way.
other_records: trail:797149498fe8 (Skyline Trail; Vmax=1.264);way/235057029 (Upper Skyline Trail; Vmax=2.130);node/348178677 (Panorama Point; Vmax=1.801)

name: Mount St Helens summit (Monitor Ridge)
justification: Crater rim view into the crater and lava dome, Spirit Lake, Rainier, Adams; unforgettable.

name: Enchantments core (Upper Enchantment Lakes / Aasgard Pass)
justification: Called the crown jewel of Washington hiking; on every statewide list; granite, glacier-fed lakes, larches.
notes: Snow Lakes Trail record runs Leavenworth-Snow Lakes-core-Aasgard; clipped to 3 km of the core.

name: Cascade Pass and Sahale Arm
justification: Often called the most scenic hike in WA; #1 on two lists; Doubtful Lake, Formidable, Johannesburg from upper Sahale Arm.
other_records: trail:043319607800 (Cascade Pass Trail; Vmax=2.047);node/4278630830 (Cascade Pass; Vmax=0.866)

name: Colchuck Lake
justification: Turquoise lake under Dragontail and Colchuck Peak; called one of the most beautiful lakes in WA; forest approach.

name: Goat Rocks (Snowgrass Flat, Old Snowy, Knife Edge)
justification: Arguably the best scenery on the northern PCT: glaciers, Rainier, Adams, St Helens; forest approach.
other_records: way/337321382 (Pacific Crest Trail (Old Snowy Alternate); Vmax=1.550);trail:5d819f16e29c (Pacific Crest Trail; Vmax=1.854; clipped);trail:12820daf0906 (Snowgrass Trail #96; Vmax=0.659)
notes: PCT record clipped to 3 km around Old Snowy / Knife Edge.

name: Royal Basin
justification: Crown jewel of the Olympic rain shadow: tarns under Mount Deception's glaciers; long forest valley.
other_records: way/37753349 (Royal Lake; Vmax=0.380);way/345402363 (Royal Basin Trail; Vmax=0.410)

name: Maple Pass Loop
justification: WTA 4.84/171; on nearly every statewide list; open larch ridge over Lake Ann with Black Peak, Frisco, Goode.

name: Summerland and Panhandle Gap
justification: Ranked #1 in the park by one guide; 360-degree view of Fryingpan Glacier, Little Tahoma, Rainier; 4 miles of forest first.
other_records: node/331233217 (Panhandle Gap; Vmax=0.980);trail:5a3df77702c5 (Summerland Trail; Vmax=0.951);trail:1b478a674a8a (Wonderland Trail; Vmax=0.265)
notes: Wonderland Trail piece clipped to 1.5 km around Summerland-Panhandle Gap.

name: Yellow Aster Butte
justification: Awe-inspiring 360 of Baker, Shuksan, Tomyhoi, Border Peaks; tarn basin; WTA 4.54/83.

name: Lake Ingalls
justification: Mount Stuart's south face across and reflected in the lake; top larch destination; upper half open.

name: Ptarmigan Ridge
justification: Some of the most spectacular views of Baker in the region, face to face with it; above treeline throughout.

name: Hidden Lake Lookout
justification: 360-degree view into the heart of North Cascades NP (Johannesburg, Forbidden, Eldorado); WTA 4.67/82.
notes: Hidden Lake Peaks high-summit node (V 1.98) excluded: hikers stop at the lookout ~0.5 km SW.

name: Skyline Divide
justification: Ridgeline with 'unrivaled mountain views', Baker looming south, Shuksan east; first 2 miles forest.

name: Tuck and Robin Lakes
justification: Granite plateau of lakes facing Mount Daniel; regarded as a top Alpine Lakes backpack; long forest approach.

name: Mount Rainier summit
justification: Climbers describe otherworldly views of every Cascade peak; most glaciated terrain in the state en route.
notes: Columbia Crest node used; the separate 'Mount Rainier' node (46.8522,-121.7575) scores 0.33.

name: High Divide / Seven Lakes Basin
justification: Premier Olympic loop: lake-dotted basin and glaciated Mount Olympus straight across the Hoh valley; WTA 4.64.
other_records: way/36745084 (High Divide Trail; Vmax=0.739);way/300960835 (Seven Lakes Basin Trail; Vmax=0.796);node/348997341 (Bogachiel Peak; Vmax=0.853);node/9488053161 (Seven Lakes Overlook; Vmax=0.820)

name: Spray Park
justification: Among the park's most vibrant meadows with close views of Rainier's NW face; 2 miles of forest first.

name: Mount Adams summit (South Climb)
justification: Volcano panorama of Rainier, St Helens, Hood, Jefferson; open snow slope with views all the way.

name: Blue Lake (Washington Pass)
justification: Accessible granite-bowl lake under Liberty Bell and Early Winters Spires; WTA 4.45/91; on two statewide lists.

name: Chelan Lakeshore Trail
justification: Fjord-like lake between high peaks, views 'amazing the entire way'; low elevation; Hunts Bluff best.

name: Spider Meadow and Spider Gap
justification: Meadow under a cirque wall, then Spider Gap over Lyman Lakes; 'some of the most spectacular views in WA' (Backpacker).
other_records: way/180523935 (Spider Gap Snowfield Route; Vmax=1.700);node/1907866645 (Spider Gap; Vmax=0.919)

name: Lake Ann (Mount Baker)
justification: Shuksan's west face and Curtis Glacier loom over the lake; regionally loved.

name: Lake Serene
justification: Mount Index's cliffs rise 3000 ft straight above the lake; WTA 4.45/419; forest-and-stairs grind.

name: Harry's Ridge
justification: Open the whole way with the crater and dome in view; Spirit Lake log raft, Adams, Rainier.

name: Thornton Lakes and Trappers Peak
justification: Trappers Peak looks straight at the Picket Range with three lakes below; rough approach; not on statewide lists.
notes: The Thornton Lakes are unnamed in OSM; lower lake way/184766397 identified by location.

name: Gothic Basin and Foggy Lake
justification: Stark, beautiful basin; Foggy Lake with Del Campo reflected; WTA 4.57/124.
other_records: relation/14888397 (Foggy Lake; Vmax=1.082);way/441565897 (Weeden Creek Trail; Vmax=0.379);way/840037164 (None; Vmax=0.974);way/840037165 (None; Vmax=0.987)
notes: Gothic Basin trail is Weeden Creek Trail plus unnamed ways in the basin (identified by location).

name: Mount Townsend
justification: 360-degree summit view of the Olympic interior, Strait, Puget Sound and volcanoes; open upper half.

name: Mount Dickerman
justification: Best vantage on the Mountain Loop: Big Four, Del Campo, Glacier Peak, Baker; WTA 4.59/128.

name: Snow Lake (Snoqualmie Pass)
justification: One of the most visited lakes in WA, under Chair Peak's cliffs; on Seattle Met top 10.

name: Hurricane Hill
justification: Open paved ridge walk; Bailey Range and Olympus south, Strait north; on nearly every Olympic best-of list.

name: Granite Mountain lookout
justification: One of the best summit views at Snoqualmie Pass: Kaleetan, Crystal Lake, Rainier; open upper half.

name: Sourdough Mountain lookout
justification: Classic 360-degree view with Diablo Lake a vertical mile below and the Pickets; brutal 5000 ft climb.
notes: OSM 'Sourdough Mountain' peak node (48.7516,-121.1279) is the true summit 1.7 km W of the lookout; not used.

name: Tolmie Peak lookout / Eunice Lake
justification: Postcard view of Eunice Lake with Rainier behind from the lookout; forested start.

name: Dog Mountain
justification: Open balsamroot slopes with sweeping Columbia River and Mt Hood views; the Gorge hike on most lists.
other_records: way/541749595 (Dog-Augspurger Tie Trail; Vmax=0.657);node/5238299339 (Dog Mountain; Vmax=0.065)

name: Lake Angeles / Klahhane Ridge
justification: Klahhane Ridge panorama of Olympus, Bailey Range and the Strait; Lake Angeles a forested cirque lake.
other_records: relation/174253 (Lake Angeles; Vmax=0.387);trail:a88d035e6654 (Lake Angeles Trail; Vmax=0.193)

name: Mount Storm King
justification: Steep forest climb to rope-assisted outcrops with an iconic bird's-eye view of Lake Crescent.

name: Mount Pilchuck lookout
justification: 360-degree lookout view of Baker, Rainier, Glacier Peak, Olympics, Sound; distant rather than close peaks.

name: Upper Lena Lake
justification: Heather meadow basin under Mount Lena and Bretherton; long steep forest climb; loved locally.

name: Mount Ellinor
justification: 360-degree summit panorama of close rugged Olympic peaks, Hood Canal, Cascade volcanoes; WTA 4.57/120.
other_records: trail:cd0493109ba6 (Mount Ellinor Trail #812; Vmax=0.451);way/271517035 (Mt. Ellinor winter route; Vmax=0.460)

name: Naches Peak Loop
justification: Best bang-for-buck hike: meadows, tarns, Rainier and Dewey Lake views; short family loop.
notes: OSM splits the loop: the PCT forms its east half, so only the 'Naches Peak Loop Trail' ways are scored.

name: Mailbox Peak
justification: Summit views as good as any along I-90, Rainier close; steep forest climb until talus near top.

name: Rachel Lake and Rampart Lakes
justification: Rampart Lakes pothole-lake plateau on the ridge above Rachel Lake is the payoff; Rachel Lake alone a 3.
other_records: relation/6520842 (Rampart Lakes; Vmax=0.213);way/125694345 (Rachel Lake Trail; Vmax=0.363);trail:9de7bda1c785 (Rampart Lakes Trail; Vmax=0.214);trail:a726ac30fcdc (Rampart Lakes Backdoor Trail; Vmax=0.287)

name: Cape Flattery
justification: Forest boardwalk to cliff-top platforms over sea caves and Tatoosh Island; bucket-list coast.

name: Rialto Beach / Hole-in-the-Wall
justification: Spectacular wild coast: sea stacks, surf, tidepools and the arch; open the whole way.
notes: Beach walk mapped as 'North Coast Beach Travelway' (clipped to 1.8 km around the Rialto-arch section).

name: Heliotrope Ridge (Coleman Glacier overlook)
justification: Close view of the Coleman Glacier icefall from the moraine; mostly forest trail; WTA 4.48/61.
notes: OSM 'Heliotrope Ridge Trail' ends at 1510 m (48.7955,-121.8685), below the moraine overlook; climbers' routes above are separate named ways.

name: Rainy Lake
justification: Short paved walk to a pretty cirque lake with waterfalls; leg-stretcher, big views are up on Maple Pass.

name: Beacon Rock
justification: Short switchback climb of a basalt monolith with Gorge views; lowland river view.

name: Lake Twenty-Two
justification: Old growth and waterfalls to a cirque lake under Pilchuck's north face; popular, not a great viewpoint.

name: Rattlesnake Ledge
justification: Open ledge view over Rattlesnake Lake and the Cedar River watershed; foothills; very popular.

name: Ebey's Landing bluff
justification: Open bluff over the Strait with Olympics across the water; very popular; lowland and marine.

name: Ancient Lakes
justification: Flood-carved basalt coulee with lakes and waterfalls; open throughout; canyon scenery, not mountains.

name: Lake Valhalla
justification: Pretty subalpine lake under Lichtenberg Mountain; solid local pick, not on statewide lists.
notes: PCT record (167 km) clipped to 3.5 km around the Stevens Pass-Valhalla section.

name: Hamilton Mountain
justification: Waterfalls plus open Gorge overlooks of Beacon Rock and Bonneville; river and foothill views.

name: Oyster Dome
justification: Beloved lowland viewpoint over Samish Bay and the San Juans; second-growth forest approach.

name: Mount Si
justification: Summit/Haystack view of Snoqualmie Valley, Rainier, Olympics; one of the best views near Seattle but lowland and distant; forest grind.
other_records: trail:0164bf6c3b70 (Mount Si Trail; Vmax=0.240);way/162157943 (Mount Si Haystack Scramble; Vmax=0.247)

name: Packwood Lake
justification: Large lake with an island and Johnson Peak behind after 4 miles of forest; popular local destination.
notes: Packwood Lake Trail record continues to Packwood Saddle (1920 m); clipped to 4.5 km covering trailhead to lake.

name: Annette Lake
justification: Forest-ringed lake under Abiel and Silver Peaks; a few talus views; nice but not a best-of.

name: Baker Lake Trail
justification: Mossy old-growth with intermittent lake glimpses; Baker across the lake at Noisy Creek.
notes: PNT record clipped to 4 km around the south trailhead-Noisy Creek section.

name: Discovery Park Loop
justification: Mostly forested loop; bluff section opens on Puget Sound and the Olympics; urban park.
other_records: trail:16488cacf7b3 (Loop Trail; Vmax=0.206);trail:5ba72662835b (Loop Trail; Vmax=0.007);way/384172551 (Loop Trail; Vmax=0.021);trail:7410a97c9acf (Loop Trail; Vmax=0.008)
notes: Loop Trail is split into several OSM records; South Beach Trail spur included.

name: Wallace Falls
justification: Forest walk past waterfalls; Middle Falls overlook has a framed valley view; borderline 2/3.

name: Mount Walker
justification: Forest switchbacks, no view until two summit viewpoints with wide but distant panoramas.

name: Poo Poo Point (Chirico Trail)
justification: Paraglider launch meadow with lowland view over Issaquah and Lake Sammamish; steep forest climb.

name: Iron Goat Trail
justification: History trail on the old railway grade, mostly forest; Windy Point the one notable view.

name: Middle Fork Snoqualmie River Trail
justification: Gentle riverside forest trail; occasional glimpses of valley walls.

name: Thunder Creek (day hike section)
justification: Old cedar forest with occasional peaks; 'the journey matters more than the destination'.
notes: Thunder Creek Trail (30 km to Park Creek Pass) clipped to 3.5 km of the usual day-hike section.

name: Green Lake (Carbon River)
justification: Inland rainforest walk, Ranger Falls and a small forest lake; no views described.

name: Talapus and Olallie Lakes
justification: Dark forest approach to pleasant forest-ringed lakes; beginner hike; no vistas described.
other_records: relation/12792230 (Olallie Lake; Vmax=0.172);trail:852832d13298 (Talapus Lake Trail; Vmax=0.169)

name: Staircase Rapids
justification: Short old-growth river loop; rapids and big cedars; no open views.

name: Marymere Falls
justification: Short old-growth walk to a 90 ft waterfall in a forest grotto; no open views.

name: Lewis River Falls
justification: Mossy old-growth river walk past big waterfalls; no open views.

name: Twin Falls (Olallie SP)
justification: Riverside forest walk to a big waterfall; people go for the falls, not views.

name: Boulder River
justification: WTA says outright no mountain views; old-growth and waterfall walk.

name: Sol Duc Falls
justification: Easy rainforest walk to a split waterfall in a mossy slot canyon; no open views.

name: Hoh River Trail / Hall of Mosses
justification: Beloved for moss-draped rainforest and elk, not views; occasional partial valley views.
notes: Hoh River Trail (26 km to Glacier Meadows) clipped to 5 km covering trailhead to Five Mile Island.

name: Franklin Falls
justification: Easy mossy forest walk to a 70 ft waterfall; no open views.

name: Grove of the Patriarchs
justification: Short old-growth boardwalk; people come for the 1000-year-old trees; no views.

name: Cougar Mountain (Wilderness Peak loop)
justification: Trip reports say plainly there are no views; people go for old growth, creeks and exercise.
